source_snapshot.procedure: Run NVQual Test #7 for input-power EDP peak testing of the system power supplies.
source_snapshot.criteria: Exercise the product's required load scenarios and meet its EDPp requirements.
source_snapshot.script: No bundle; 60/60 minutes; unique GB-NV-PVP code/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; correctly requires NVQual/HMC and power instrumentation but lacks the measurement window, scenario/limit bindings, waveform quality and electrical/thermal safety.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CRITICAL; held Pending for NVQual recipe, EDPp definition, calibrated acquisition and recovery.

old_problem: The product EDPp number, tolerance, time/aggregation window, measurement point, scenario matrix and versioned NVQual/HMC recipe are absent, so the prior review kept the case Pending and could not accept a low-rate telemetry maximum as compliance evidence.
disposition_reason: The test objective and named vendor workflow are unambiguous: execute NVQual Test #7 across the product scenarios and compare calibrated input-power transients with the product EDPp contract. Under the user's parameterization rule and ED-14/15, the missing recipe artifact, limit/window, scenarios and lab values are explicit Project Configuration Requirements; they prevent execution/PASS but do not require another review-layer decision. The record preserves raw waveform and per-scenario coverage and forbids threshold inference.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2098, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2099 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00021-V002 / 53d46ab928ffb484 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
NVQual Test #7/HMC is a required versioned vendor package/configuration, not a command to invent; execution remains closed until it is supplied and compatibility is verified.
EDPp PASS requires the project limit, tolerance, measurement domain/point, peak/integration window and exact comparison rule; no value may be borrowed from another product.
Every required load scenario, duration, entry condition and repetition remains separately visible; a single favorable peak cannot replace the scenario matrix.
Use calibrated input voltage/current/power acquisition with approved bandwidth, sample rate, range and synchronized phase markers; low-rate BMC/PSU telemetry is supplemental only.
Validate PSU population, cords/PDU/facility capacity, cooling and emergency stop; set current/voltage/thermal/reset/data-loss aborts and a cooldown/recovery plan.
Retain complete raw waveforms, harness output and health logs; check clipping/gaps/units and recalculate the metric reproducibly before comparing with the supplied requirement.
No NVQual/HMC, workload, instrument connection, power stress, protection change, recovery, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Parameterized NVQual Test #7 calibrated input-power EDPp compliance
test_case.purpose: Demonstrate that the GB-NV-PVP system/PSU input path satisfies the signed product EDPp transient contract in every required NVQual Test #7 load scenario using calibrated synchronized measurements.
required_package: Pinned owner-approved NVQual Test #7/HMC package, license, command and immutable configuration
Product EDPp limit, tolerance, measurement point/domain, peak or integration window and pass rule
Calibrated isolated input-power instrumentation with approved range/bandwidth/sample rate/time synchronization
Approved PSU/cable/PDU/facility/cooling envelope, abort limits, emergency stop, cooldown and recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until all Project Configuration fields are bound. Then qualified lab personnel verify wiring/calibration/facility/cooling and establish idle health; after point approval invoke the exact supplied NVQual Test #7/HMC recipe for each required scenario once as specified while recording synchronized full-rate voltage/current/power waveforms, harness phase markers and platform thermal/health data. Stop on any approved abort, preserve complete raw traces, validate data quality, compute EDPp with the signed window/rule and compare each scenario independently. Do not infer limits, use low-rate telemetry as authority, bypass protection or blindly rerun.
test_case.expected_result: For every signed scenario, acquisition remains valid and unclipped, the reproducibly calculated EDPp at the specified point/window is within the product limit and tolerance, no electrical/thermal/reset/health abort occurs, and the system completes the approved cooldown/recovery state.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until the signed product EDPp contract and complete Project Configuration are present. Thereafter PASS requires valid calibrated traces and in-limit results for every scenario plus healthy exit. FAIL on any over-limit scenario, clipping/gap that invalidates its trace, wrong measurement domain, protection/thermal excursion, reset or recovery failure. Missing package/spec/calibration/authorization is BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until versioned recipe, numeric EDPp contract, scenario matrix, lab topology and abort/recovery are approved.
Qualified power-lab personnel validate isolation, ratings, calibration, wiring, facility and cooling before point authorization.
Keep all electrical/thermal protections active and an emergency stop available; never bypass interlocks.
Abort and preserve first evidence on excursion, clipping, data loss, reset or instability; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: NVQual/HMC versions, license/config checksum, exact command and scenario plan
Calibration certificates, wiring diagram, instrument range/bandwidth/sample rate and clock-sync proof
Complete per-scenario raw voltage/current/power traces, harness phase/status and platform thermal/health logs
Data-quality report, reproducible calculations/comparisons, abort/cooldown/recovery evidence and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On any electrical/thermal limit, clipping/data loss, reset or abnormal health, stop the workload through the approved emergency path, preserve traces and do not rerun. Isolate or cool down under the lab plan and quarantine the system/input path until engineering disposition.

source_conflict.reason: Procedure and criteria consistently request product EDPp compliance; the absent artifacts and values are explicit project configuration, not a conflicting source claim.

blocked.reason: The review-layer method, safety boundary and PASS structure are complete; execution may be BLOCKED later if required project inputs are not supplied.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Pinned NVQual/HMC recipe, product EDPp numeric/window contract, scenario matrix, calibrated lab topology, facility/cooling/abort limits and recovery.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED; PARAMETERIZED EDPP LAB TEST GATE CLOSED; NO NVQUAL/HMC, WORKLOAD, INSTRUMENT CONNECTION, POWER STRESS, PROTECTION CHANGE, RECOVERY, RETRY OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.owner: GB-NV-PVP power/product owner and qualified power lab
pending.unlock_condition: Bind and approve all listed Project Configuration and receive point authorization; missing values block execution and PASS but no new review-layer decision is needed.

external_authorities.application: Allows a parameterized project-threshold test while preserving full duration/scenarios, direct evidence, safety gates and no unapproved PASS or retry.

project_authority: Product/power owner supplies EDPp contract and scenarios; NVQual owner supplies recipe; accredited lab owns instrumentation/safety; platform owner owns cooling/recovery; engineer issues verdict.
